# jsQR 1.4.0

`jsQR.js` and `LICENSE` come from the npm package `jsqr@1.4.0`, published by [cozmo/jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR). The decoder is byte-for-byte unchanged; the license's terminal blank line was removed. The package tarball is `jsqr-1.4.0.tgz`, integrity `sha512-dxLob7q65Xg2DvstYkRpkYtmKm2sPJ9oFhrhmudT1dZvNFFTlroai3AWSpLey/w5vMcLBXRgOJsbXpdN9HzU/A==`. The `jsQR.js` SHA-256 is `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`.

The browser loads this decoder from its own origin only after a person starts scanning. It reads camera pixels locally; the app passes a validated invitation fragment to the existing pairing path.
